it.q: Quanto costa un affitto transitorio a Chiaia, Napoli?
it.a: Da €3.750 a €7.000 al mese, tutto incluso. Il monolocale di 40 mq va da €5.000 su 3 mesi a €3.750 su 18 mesi. Le unità da 60 mq da €6.000 a €4.700. L'appartamento di 95 mq per 6 persone da €7.000 a €5.750.
Un mese, massimo 18. Per soggiorni da 1 a 3 mesi il canone è su richiesta, in base a unità e periodo. Sotto i 30 giorni proponiamo la formula turistica.

Due pulizie complete a settimana, cambio biancheria da letto settimanale, asciugamani su richiesta, ripristino delle dotazioni. Tutto svolto dal nostro personale dedicato, un solo interlocutore per tutta la durata.

Sì, a pagamento. Ritiro e riconsegna degli indumenti gestiti direttamente dal personale.

en.q: How much does a mid-term rental in Chiaia, Naples cost?
en.a: From €3,750 to €7,000 a month, all inclusive. The 40 sqm studio goes from €5,000 on a 3 month lease to €3,750 on 18 months. The 60 sqm units from €6,000 to €4,700. The 95 sqm apartment for 6 people from €7,000 to €5,750.
One month, up to a maximum of 18. For stays of 1 to 3 months the rent is quoted on request, depending on the unit and the period. Under 30 days we offer the short-stay formula.
Two full cleans a week, weekly change of bed linen, towels on request, restocking of supplies. All carried out by our own staff, with a single point of contact for the whole stay.

en.q: Do I need to be resident in Naples?
en.a: No. The transitional lease is designed for people whose residence is elsewhere and who are in the city for work, an assignment or a renovation.

en.q: Can my company sign the lease?
en.a: Yes. We put the lease in the company's name and invoice monthly. We need a company registration extract and the legal representative's ID.

en.q: Can I have a parking space?
en.a: Yes, as an extra service. Car and motorcycle parking in the garage of the same building, covered, 24 hour access, video surveillance and EV charging. Monthly rate reserved for tenants, availability subject to confirmation.
